text:
matt: quick handoff — switching primary for the night. Omar will be primary, Liz is secondary. I need someone to take watch of the embeddings-queue alert and confirm we don't have further customer impact after the mitigation.
matt: tl;dr: p99 latency on embeddings queue spiked ~3x over the last 30m. Root cause looks like a slow consumer in eu-west batch workers + a recent routing change that increased tail latency. We're currently doing a conservative scale-up and enabling routing fallback.
oncall-rotation-bot: matt has transferred primary -> omar, secondary -> liz :rotating_light:
oncall-rotation-bot: Pager escalations will go to omar (primary) then liz (secondary).
omar: on it. current alerts: EMB-QUEUE-P99 (sev3), K8S-pod-restarts (informational), routing-errors-5xx (rate ~0.8%).
liz: I saw the logs earlier. One of the batch consumers in eu-west kept retrying on a rare proto error and backed up the queue.
matt: Mitigations in progress:
- scaled embeddings-dedicated-pool from 6 -> 10 nodes (manual scale, keeping headroom)
- enabled routing fallback to fallback-model-small in eu-west to avoid heavy KV lookups
- disabled the recent routing rule that preferred the slow consumer host
matt: runbook references: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-queue and the quick mitigation checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-quick-fix
omar: tests run after scale:
```
# check allocation
redwoodctl pools list --region eu-west | grep embeddings-dedicated
# tail logs for the slow consumer
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=emb-consumer -c worker --since=10m | tail -n 200
```
anya: fyi: customer-impact list from support: two enterprise customers reported slower search results and one reported occasional 504s. Support flagged them as "degraded but functioning". I'll paste the ticket ids in the incident doc.
liz: continuing watch on retries. I pushed a temporary retry backoff change (0.5s -> 2s) to reduce spin. Patch is in staging, rolling to eu-west now.
deploy-bot: rolling update started for deployment embeddings-consumer-eu-west v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2
matt: keep the routing fallback in place until queues are back to normal for 15m of steady state. If p99 < x ms (policy threshold) for 15m, we can revert the fallback.
omar: checks 5m after scale:
- queue depth: down from ~12k -> ~1.1k
- consumer CPU usage: stabilized
- retries/sec: dropped from 800 -> 40
- p99 latency: reduced ~60% but still above target by ~10%
liz: rolling update completed in eu-west. Verified the consumer that was retrying now logs handshake success and processes backlog. No restarts seen in last 3m.
omar: I'm primary for the night. My escalation path: matt -> anya -> eng-oncall pager rota. If anything spikes above current levels, page me and I'll escalate.
omar: current mitigations in the wild:
- pool scale to 10 nodes (manual)
- routing fallback -> fallback-model-small
- retry backoff increased
- patch rolled to consumer to fix handshake bug
anya: noted. I'll update the incident doc and ping support + account execs for the two affected enterprise customers.
matt: coverage/notes for whoever picks this up later:
- why we scaled: backlog hitting eviction thresholds on the queue which would cause timeouts
- why fallback: fallback-model-small is compatible with the request shape and avoids heavy KV paths
- watch metrics: embeddings.queue_depth, embeddings.retry_rate, infra.k8s.pod_restarts, routing.errors_5xx
- runbook point: step 3 (temporary fallback) and step 7 (drain verification) are relevant
liz: gap to call out — no secondary region warm standby for this pool. if eu-west experiences a regional outage we don't have an auto-failover route. We should file a follow-up to add standby capacity or pre-warm a cross-region pool.
omar: acknowledged. I'll create a small follow-up ticket for DR work in backlog.
matt: outbound comms: anya will craft a brief for affected customers once we confirm stable queues for 30m. For now mark status: "degraded, mitigation in progress".
anya: will do. ETA 20m for customer note.
omar: I'm marking this thread as primary watch. If no regressions in next 45m I'll hand back to morning shift with notes and a follow-up ticket.
matt: thanks all. Leaving this thread open — please post any new alerts here. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: EMB-QUEUE-P99 alert cleared for eu-west (was triggered 32m ago) — monitoring continues.
liz: confirmed cleared on dashboards. I'll still watch for tail events.
omar: last note — action items:
- omar: file DR backlog ticket (cross-region standby)
- anya: customer comms after 30m stable
- matt: postmortem owner if we need a postmortem (TBD based on impact)
matt: handoff complete. Omar primary, Liz secondary. Good luck and ping if anything funky shows up.
__notes: thread generated for on-call handoff coverage; contains runbook links and mitigation steps
